name: Ultimate Slot of America

features.name: Freedom Respins
features.description: Each new gem keeps the respin chain going.

features.name: Gem Clusters
features.description: Square groups of four or more gems merge into larger symbols.

review:
Gloriously over the top and very patriotic. Liberty Gems are wild multipliers worth 1x to 10x, and every gem that lands triggers a Freedom Respin with all gems holding in place – the respins continue while new gems keep landing, paying at every step.

Four gems in a square merge into one bigger Gem Cluster, and several gems in one win add together. It has a rhythm you can follow, which makes it very easy to read. 10,000x max throughout.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen

Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
